description: Commit 89f6401 makes transformer branches optional but leaves each branch input y initialized only when its optional input norm exists.
trigger: Run a present attention branch without attn_norm, or a present MLP branch without mlp_norm.
expected_behavior: A branch without input normalization receives the current residual state x.
actual_behavior: Attention without its norm and MLP without its norm when attention is absent read unassigned y; an unnormalized MLP after attention reuses the attention output rather than the updated residual state.

introductions.scope: The task diff adds optional branch and norm guards while leaving y assignment inside the norm guards.

observations.source: Teacher source inspection confirmed by independent Fable mailbox review.
observations.reach: The three in-tree model builders supply both input norms.
observations.limits: No tensor forward path ran; external and dynamically constructed blocks were not inspected.

verification.tree_scope: Commit 89f6401 introduction and in-tree TransformerBlock builders.
limits: No model forward path was executed.
In-tree builders do not omit the norms.

impact.rationale: The source failures and wrong-input path are definite for missing norms, but in-tree builders always supply both norms.
